title: Falling Pink Haired Warrior
description: A three-panel vertical sequence shows a female character with bright pink curly hair in green and black armor. In the left panel she runs forward with a surprised expression, in the middle panel she is upside down mid-fall with her cape flaring, and in the right panel she lies flat on her back with bubbles floating around her head.
prompt: A three-panel vertical comic sequence on a solid bright green background. Left panel: a surprised young female warrior with voluminous pink curly pigtails, green and black armor with gold trim, green cape, and black boots runs forward. Middle panel: the same character is upside down, falling through the air with her cape flaring and bubbles around her head. Right panel: she lies flat on her back on the ground with one leg up, dazed expression, and bubbles floating above her head. Cartoon style, clean line art, vibrant colors.
